name: xrt
description: Thin wrapper that exposes the system-installed AMD XRT (Xilinx Runtime) to vcpkg consumers on Linux: its CMake configs (xrt, with XRT::xrt_coreutil, and aiebu) and, to dependent portfiles, its install root and xclbinutil. XRT is not built here: the runtime has to be the system one, matched to the installed NPU driver plugin (libxrt_driver_xdna). Located via XILINX_XRT (what XRT's setup.sh exports), default /opt/xilinx/xrt. Requires XRT 2.25 or newer.
